chunk.text: Sofia, Lucy, and White sat on a picnic blanket in the church backyard, the sun casting warm shadows over the grass. Lucy twisted her hands anxiously, her eyes darting between her friends. 'What if they find out I've been lying? I can't face them if they know the truth,' she said, her voice barely above a whisper. White leaned forward, his tone more confident than usual. 'You can say you've been helping out at the church. Sofia can back you up with the event details.' Sofia nodded, her calm demeanor soothing the group. 'That's a good idea, White. But we need to make sure it's consistent and believable. We should check if the church has recent events we can reference.' Lucy looked up at Sofia, her eyes pleading. 'I don't want to lie, but I don't know what else to do. I just need to get through this.' Sofia's analytical side kicked in as she proposed a plan. 'Let's not call it a lie. We can say you've been helping with the youth outreach program. It's true, and we can back it up with details from the last meeting.'
